notes.title: Harem in Another World v0.9 development update
notes.notes:
​Hi All,  



Just thought I'd let you know how the development of the v0.9 update is coming along. I post devlogs every two weeks online but thought I would drop a wider, summary devlog here to keep you guys informed. The current release date is set as the 23rd September! That might move a week either side but expect it around that time. 

This next update is shaping up to be a bumper one, with around twice as much new content as the last update! New scenes, new main story, new relationship quests, new outfits, new upgrades. There's a whole load of great stuff being added, I'm excited for you all to play it. 

First off, thank you to everyone who participated in the feedback survey, it's been very useful to me and it was great hearing all of your lovely feedback! The survey is still live if you haven't participated yet, just check the previous news post. There are lots of QoL improvements coming out off the back of that, I thought I'd shout out a couple of them here: 

The vast majority of players sped up combat, so I'm changing the default speed to "fast". You will still be able to slow it down to the original speed or sped it up to Ultra fast.

I'll be adding an option to change the colour of your banners and your castle guards after purchasing them, so you're not stuck with one colour. 

I'll be adding a signpost near Halden so it's clearer that you can walk along the beach to get there, as some people got lost at that section

I've removed the option to be able to equip things to the girls. You couldn't actually put anything on them anyway, but the menu still existed  

This is by no means all of the changes, just some that came from the survey and can be easily put into a bullet point. At the same time I did a full run through of the game and ended up with 14 full pages of notes! So there's been a lot of small improvements and tune up taking place across the game. 

I don't want to get too deep into the censorship discussion, my assumption is if you are reading this you already know about Steam and Itch's crackdown caused by mastercard and visa. Plus the UK requiring ID checks to look at adult content, just a big old shit show all round. Harem in Another World has not been banned from either platform which is good, but it is still de-listed from itch. Which in short terms means my income just got cut by around 50%. This doesn't stop me working, but it makes the day to day of paying artists and animators a lot more difficult.  

If you have any questions, or if you just want to chat, you can drop into the discord server here: https://discord.gg/6M2C7Pupvz  

Catch you in the next update!  

Love  

Jong

notes.title: Harem in Another World v0.8 progress update
notes.notes:
Hi All,

Thought I would update you all on the progress made for the latest update. Expected release date is end of August to mid September. I post regular updates, sketches and polls on Discord and patreon. I thought I could put together a quick summary post to go here to keep you all informed about some of the upcoming changes. So here's a non exhaustive summary of the key changes discussed in the devlogs since the last major release.


 Madeline won the content poll so is getting a number of new scenes in her personal story line in the next update. 
 The next update is going to be mainly focused on the girls individual stories and them interacting with each other rather than the main quest.
 Currently around 12 new scenes planned, even more than the last update! Not all of these are spicy some are more character focused
 I'm implementing an outfit change system, so you can adjust how your girls will dress at home and when they follow you around (If they agree to wear the outfit). This changes the in game sprite and the character image when talking to them. There's also going to be special scenes for certain outfits.
 Boss battle system has been improved so it looks better, is easier to see and should be more responsive.
 The next update will have the first impregnation/pregnancy scene included. This is for one of the side characters not any of the main girls yet.
 Overhaul of a lot of the early sprite artwork like Ruth so it better matches how her character looks.
 Large number of minor changes to the intro and first part of the game to improve polish.
 There was a poll about adding "Moan" sound effects to the game, which had an overwhelming 95% vote yes. So I'm adding in sound effects to all new and existing scenes. 
 A new teleport tab has been added to the nomad camp to reduce the amount of running back and forth in the desert in the early game.
 The key for saving Orla no longer requires the upgraded boat to reach it
 Completing the bank quest now has much lower requirements and unlocks a walk in safe in your house with a pile of money that grows and shrinks depending on you cash level.


That's a brief overview of the main points, if you want a more in depth read the devlogs are all publicly available :) .

Catch you in the next update!

Jong

notes.title: Harem in Another World v0.65 release!
notes.notes:
The latest version of Harem in another world is now available to download!

This is primarily a bug fix build but there is two things which warrant a separate version, those being the new intro scene and the new autosave system. The game will now autosave any time you teleport or enter a town centre or home. 

Full Changelog:


 1 New scene, Sasha in intro. The introduction scene with Sasha and the king has been re-written and has new art to go along with it. The old version is still available in the recollection room.
 Implemented Autosave system, the game will autosave at regular points, a small pink heart will appear at the bottom right when autosaving, autosaves are stored in save slot 20
 Fix Achievements not working on Steam. If you have missed them there is a fix in the fairies office in the recollection room
 Fix Brazila image not loading on Android
 Updated hint system so it's clearer it gives resource hints as well
 Adjusted crowd sound whilst entering buildings in Rome
 Fix walking under roof Roma
 Fix collision problem in assassin house
 Fix random crash when using certain graphics cards
 Fix being able to clip through the teleporter in Haleden
 Changed secret stash hint to sun rise not sun set, I got east and west mixed up...
